reviewer: Independent screenshot reviewer; documented internal 0–10 assessment, not a human-user survey, award, release authority or performance waiver.
method: Production Chromium. CDP CPU 4x, published-financial baseline versus certified-financial candidate; identical verified prices, different financial inputs; not a UI-only speed comparison, HTTP responses cached in memory after warm-up. No human satisfaction inference.
review_scope: All 134 screen keys from the exact observed capture, including 28 financial views and the final shared components/dependencies. No old task-isolated screenshots were scored. No new X-feed work is included.

rating_rubric.scale: 0–10. The repository threshold is 8.0 for each dimension; it is not an automatic score floor. Ratings were assigned after image inspection.
rating_rubric.design: Visible hierarchy, spacing, color distinction, labels and coherence of the captured composition.
rating_rubric.usability: Readability and discoverability in the supplied viewport; static screenshots do not prove every interaction. Deliberate scrolling is acknowledged without claiming off-screen content is visible.
rating_rubric.originality: Purposeful domain-specific adaptation and coherent relationships between evidence, screening and chart context; not a claim of novel invention.
rating_rubric.content: Visible number/state semantics, dates, currency/units, source qualifications, negative values and avoidance of false pass or historical-availability claims.
rating_rubric.financial_scrolling: The evidence and annual-specific captures are separate ordinary scrolled viewports. The annual-specific companion proves visibility of the annual target, not that the entire financial section fits above the fold.

subjective_review_status: ACCEPTED within the exact 134-key nonperformance screenshot scope. No blocking pixel defect or visible false-pass financial state was identified. Verbose annual explanations and scroll-dependent detail remain acknowledged limitations.
objective_nonperformance_status: PASSED in the supplied exact report: all 134 records have empty target-size, font, radius, ASCII-negative and axe findings, and no page horizontal overflow. Normal-motion capture records contain 1–2 running animations in nine screens; the separately executed reduced-motion assertion is not listed as a failure. This reviewer verified the recorded arrays/flags; did not rerun the browser harness.
objective_gate_status: FAILED. Four original failure records preserve two radar first-paint misses: 58.4 ms desktop and 51.1 ms mobile against 50 ms. Subjective scores do not override them.

performance_observations.source: Values read from this report; no new timing run performed by this reviewer.

supplemental_production_bootstrap.scope: Supplemental synthetic production-shaped metadata; exact candidate assets/data unchanged. No release authority or replacement of primary budget trials.
supplemental_production_bootstrap.method: Three fresh browser/HTTP contexts per viewport, CPU 4x, actual app ready rows plus two animation frames. Public ledger fields retained; approval omitted.

performance_observations.causal_limit: Baseline and candidate use identical verified prices but different financial inputs. Neither the primary comparison nor supplemental metadata cold timings establish that transport alone caused a speed change. Supplemental trials do not replace primary budgets or confer release authority.
